patch.summary: Apollo.io migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Apollo.io by inventorying legacy sales-intelligence fields, mapping them to Apollo.io objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Apollo.io migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, prospecting, data enrichment and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Apollo.io; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Salesforce; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Outbound and growth sales teams outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.
If Apollo.io mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Lusha before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Salesforce in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Credits and record-selection limits govern data usage; Unlimited plans subject to fair-use policy.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Seat + credit consumption can rise quickly for heavy outbound teams; Enterprise is custom quote.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.
